subject: Television & Streaming
title: Jenji Kohan's Outsider Stories
description: A quick, practical guide to Jenji Kohan's Outsider Stories.

hook.text: Jenji Kohan pitched Orange Is the New Black by saying a white woman was the Trojan horse for diverse stories.

buildup.text: Piper Kerman's memoir got the show greenlit, but Kohan used her as a gateway to tell stories of women society ignores.

discovery.text: The show gave screen time to trans women, immigrants, and working-class inmates—people rarely seen as TV protagonists.

twist.text: Kohan previously created Weeds, about a suburban mom selling marijuana.

climax.text: OITNB was one of Netflix's first original hits.

punchline.text: She used a privileged character to tell unprivileged stories.

quiz.question: What strategy did Jenji Kohan use to get Orange Is the New Black made?
options: Using a white protagonist as a 'Trojan horse' for diverse stories
